mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS quantity, wm.sys_classify FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id LEFT JOIN work_menu wm ON pm.business_key = wm.module_code WHERE 1 = 1 AND pm.approve_status = #{approveStatus} AND ptm.cur_approve_id = #{userId} GROUP BY wm.sys_classify

SELECT count(*) AS quantity, wm.sys_classify FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id LEFT JOIN work_menu wm ON pm.business_key = wm.module_code WHERE 1 = 1 AND (pm.approve_status = #{approveStatus} OR pm.approve_status = 'reject') AND ptm.cur_approve_id = #{userId} AND wm.sys_classify = #{sysClassify} GROUP BY wm.sys_classify

SELECT count(*) AS quantity, wm.sys_classify FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id LEFT JOIN work_menu wm ON pm.business_key = wm.module_code WHERE 1 = 1 AND ptm.create_user_id = #{userId} AND wm.sys_classify = #{sysClassify} GROUP BY wm.sys_classify
